title: Full-stack Developer
description:
About &facts

At &facts, we're on a mission to help eCommerce brands make better decisions through data-driven insights. We're a high-growth, VC-backed start-up with ambitious plans. As one of our first employees, you'll have the opportunity to shape the business and make a meaningful impact on our success.

What we're looking for...

We're looking for a hands-on Full-stack Developer with the technical skills and aptitude to build a technology platform from scratch to help businesses make better decisions. You'll have utilised various data sources in previous roles including open/public data, web analytics data, traffic data, APIs and web scraping. You will have also worked on data visualisation.

You will get to...

  • Collaborate with the team to design and develop new features for our platform.

  • Maintain and optimise our current codebase.

  • Write reusable and efficient code.

  • Test and debug code, and participate in code reviews.

  • Manage AWS instances and services.

  • Set up and maintain Docker containers and CI/CD pipeline.

Must have...

  • Prior experience in building and maintaining web applications and platforms

  • Experience with Python and/or Django for backend

  • Experience with React and/or JavaScript for frontend

  • Good knowledge of AWS services like EC2 instances, Lambda, SES, Caching Servers, and PostgresSQL databases.

  • Solid experience with Git and GitHub.

  • Solid understanding of best practices such as CI/CD, TDD etc

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.

  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively.

Good to have...

  • Familiarity with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or DynamoDB.

  • Experience with agile methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban.

  • Experience with container orchestration tools like Kubernetes.

  • Familiarity with security principles and best practices.

  • Knowledge of data visualization tools such as Chart.js and D3.js.

  • Experience in designing and maintaining ETL processes.

  • Utilised a variety of data sources in previous roles including familiarity with REST APIs

We will give you...

  • Experience in working for a high-growth VC-backed start-up

  • Meaningful share options as one of the earliest team members

  • The ability to work flexibly

  • Equipment of your choice

  • A competitive salary based on your skill and experience

  • Excellent healthcare cover

Work Location: Hybrid Remote from UK
Must have the right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to sponsor currently.

Strictly no recruiters or agencies.
